instruction: ARTBOOK FIRST remains the production gate. Every existing Web game and daechung-rpg must receive five independent initial department artbooks before formal production progresses. The artbooks must not be uniform templates: only the evidence/quality gate and storage schema are shared. Each game must use its own artbook identity, visual language, narrative focus, and signature sections from artbook-style-profiles.json, and each department must express its own specialty rather than copying another department. Story causality remains the highest gate: character, monster, boss, environment, quest, combat, progression, UI/intro/audio direction must make coherent sense together. Existing code/web games/Unity work remain prototype evidence only. ChatGPT/director must not author missing department artbooks. Existing homepage publication approval remains only for daechung-rpg; do not extend it to other games. Never modify web-games source files and never use paid automation or paid runners.
